description: This file defines the DirectEditingRepository class responsible for managing direct editing URLs for notes in the app. It interacts with server settings and files API to obtain URLs for editing notes.

classes.name: DirectEditingRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing functionality to fetch direct editing URLs for notes via network calls.

methods.name: getDirectEditingUrl
methods.description: Fetches the URL for direct editing of a note, involving retrieval of server settings and API calls to fetch the URL.

methods.name: getNotesPath
methods.description: Private method to retrieve the notes path from server settings for a given user account.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton pattern implementation to obtain an instance of DirectEditingRepository with application context.
